reports.title: NorthWestern Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: FINANCIAL OUTLOOK
section: Affirming 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Growth Rates

As noted above, we anticipate completing the merger with Black Hills by year-end 2026. The financial guidance and long-term outlook presented below reflect NorthWestern Energy on a standalone basis. Upon completion of the merger, NorthWestern’s standalone guidance and outlook will no longer apply or be indicative of the combined company’s expected results.
